English version in below
◎時間：2025.7.5~2025.7.25
◎地點：美國Minnesota State University, Mankato
◎費用：USD 2800 約新台幣90,000 （費用中不包含飲食、個人旅遊費用）

◎報名時間：2025.4.1截止

◎報名流程
1.填寫google 表單向國際處報名，同時繳交以下文件：
Google form：https://reurl.cc/2jAzQ9
在學證明
家長同意書 (下載範本Form：海外短期交流家長同意書https://oia.ndhu.edu.tw/var/file/27/1027/img/920907695.doc)
2.國際處會協助提名給主辦單位 
3.等待姐妹校通知

◎欲知詳情，請詳閱附件或遊覽影片及官網：
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=S8gW4CKujkY
https://www.mnsu.edu/academics/global-education/centers-of-global-education/center-for-english-language-programs/about-center-for-english-language-program/

◎注意事項：
1.有任何申請問題可以聯繫活動承辦人: celp@mnsu.edu
2.具體申請細節及其他資訊請詳閱簡章。
3.國際處僅公告或協助本校學生報名參加簽約校的短期活動或課程，其短期課程是否可抵免本校學分，參加學生需遵照教務處相關規定辦理。若活動日期為本校學期上課期間，學生須依照本校規定自行辦理請假手續。

English version
◎Period：2025.7.5~2025.7.25
◎Location：Minnesota State University, Mankato, USA
◎Fee：USD 2800 around NTD90,000 Fee does not include food costs, individual travelling plans.

◎Registration Deadline：Until 2025.4.1

◎Registration Process
1. Sign up via google form and upload below documents to OIA.
Google form：https://reurl.cc/2jAzQ9
Student Status Certificate
Parental Consent Letter(Form：Parental Consent Letter https://oia.ndhu.edu.tw/var/file/27/1027/img/920907695.doc)
2. OIA will assist in the nomination process
3. Await the announcement from sister school.

◎For further information, please check the attached file, watch the linked video or visit their website.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=S8gW4CKujkY
https://www.mnsu.edu/academics/global-education/centers-of-global-education/center-for-english-language-programs/about-center-for-english-language-program/

◎Please note:
1.For any application inquiries, please contact the program organizer at: celp@mnsu.edu
2.For detailed application instructions and other information, please refer to the brochure.
3.OIA only announces or assists our school’s students in registering for short-term activities or courses offered by contracted schools. Whether credits from these short-term courses can be transferred to our school is subject to the regulations of the Academic Affairs Office, and participating students must comply accordingly. If the activity falls within our school’s academic semester, students must follow our school’s regulations to apply for leave of absence.
